If you are working on Databricks, understanding Unity Catalog is very important for interviews and real projects.
It is used for data governance, security, and access control across all workspaces.
𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗶𝘀 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗖𝗮𝘁𝗮𝗹𝗼𝗴?
Centralized governance for data & AI assets
Control access at catalog / schema / table level
Built-in auditing & lineage
Works across multiple Databricks workspaces
Supports tables, views, volumes, models, functions
𝗨𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗖𝗮𝘁𝗮𝗹𝗼𝗴 𝗛𝗶𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗵𝘆 (𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄 𝗙𝗮𝘃𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗲)
Metastore
→ Catalog
→ Schema (Database)
→ Table / View / Volume / Model / Function
This hierarchy is very commonly asked in Databricks interviews.
𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗙𝗲𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲𝘀
✔ Centralized access control
✔ Data lineage tracking
✔ Data discovery & tagging
✔ External location support
✔ Workspace-level access control
✔ Secure storage credentials

Separate UC for Dev / QA / Prod Env data
Restrict sensitive data access
Manage S3 / ADLS Gen2 storage securely
Control permissions using SQL GRANT
Share data across workspaces
